$Comment: The undead roles the game's Undead group leaves out, by their role names. Zig_Foe_Undead includes this group before it leaves out every boss and elite, so a boss or an elite named like one of these never comes back into the family: the game reads a group's included groups, then its excluded groups, then its own role names, so a family names its extra roles through a group like this one, never through IncludeRoles of its own.
